name: cyclus
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.6.0"

package:
  name: cyclus
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7105437182e8b39d27b9c89daec60c8a582113022ba9d8b409ce0df0a9cf50ce
  patches:
    # GCC 15 rejects the const-method write; upstream cyclus/cyclus@723619f301
    # from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1814
    - patches/make-dirty_quantity_-mutable.patch
    # Boost >= 1.86 changed sha1::digest_type; minimal backport of the fix in
    # https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1792
    - patches/support-the-Boost-1.86-sha1-digest_type.patch
    # keep LDFLAGS (-L$PREFIX/lib, rpath) when linking shared libs on Linux; upstream
    # only fixed the macOS branch (see changed-CMakeLists.txt-... below)
    - patches/append-to-CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS-instead-of-replacing-it.patch
    # Boost >= 1.86 uuid is no longer brace-initialisable; upstream cyclus/cyclus@e77848ce86
    # from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1792
    - patches/construct-uuid-correctly.patch
    # (int)1e299 is INT_MIN with GCC 15, hanging MixedActiveDormant; upstream
    # cyclus/cyclus@9c2e0196b0 from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1757
    - patches/do-not-pass-1e299-as-an-int-bound.patch
    # Cython 3.1 removed the PyString_* cimports, the `long` builtin, and the
    # ambiguous annotations() overload; upstream cyclus/cyclus@7ca5ef6348,
    # cyclus/cyclus@af9421daf4, and cyclus/cyclus@2f3c175e0a from
    # https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1985
    - patches/remove-the-unused-cimport-of-PyString_FromString.patch
    - patches/remove-the-checks-for-the-Python-2-long-type-in-nucname.patch
    - patches/call-annotations-of-the-agent-shims-through-the-Agent-base-class.patch
    # distutils was removed from the stdlib in Python 3.12; upstream
    # cyclus/cyclus@dc1b04b9fb from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1985
    - patches/remove-the-uses-of-distutils.patch
    # on macOS only the cyclus executable linked libpython, and -dead_strip_dylibs
    # drops it there as cyclus.cc uses no Python symbols itself, so dyld aborts on
    # the Python symbols of libcyclus; link libcyclus to libpython on every
    # platform as upstream cyclus/cyclus@2b5d4bc09f from
    # https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1814
    - patches/only-link-libcyclus-explicitly-to-python-libraries.patch
    # Python only imports extension modules named .so, but on macOS the pymodule,
    # eventhooks, and pyinfile modules were installed to site-packages as .dylib;
    # upstream cyclus/cyclus@26a7eef5a6 from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1814
    - patches/create-so-symlink-to-libraries-instead-of-second-installation.patch
    # with the default two-level namespace on macOS, libcyclus binds its Python
    # symbols to libpython, a second copy of the interpreter in a python process
    # (the conda-forge python executable links Python statically), which
    # segfaults on import; upstream cyclus/cyclus@427c5440ef from
    # https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1814
    - patches/add-flat_namespace-flag-on-macos.patch
    # keep LDFLAGS (-L$PREFIX/lib) when linking shared libs on macOS; upstream
    # cyclus/cyclus@c768b40bb2 from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1970
    - patches/changed-CMakeLists.txt-to-address-the-MacOS-CI-tests-failing.patch
    # test_env.py looks for libagents.so, which is libagents.dylib on macOS;
    # upstream cyclus/cyclus@776efd5b32 from https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1814
    - patches/look-for-library-with-platform-specific-file-extension.patch
    # CompMathTests.ApplyThresholdMedium dereferences and increments an iterator
    # to a map node that ApplyThreshold has just erased, which segfaults
    # depending on whether the allocator reuses the freed node (seen on
    # osx-arm64); upstream cyclus/cyclus@40ff4190ec from
    # https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1965
    - patches/fix-questionable-memory-access-in-test.patch

build:
  number: 9
  skip:
    - win

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # the PyNE CRAM solver (cram.c) is C
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - pkg-config
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
  host:
    - coin-or-cbc
    - libboost-devel
    # headers and libxml++-4.0.pc moved out of libxmlpp-4.0 into libxmlpp-devel
    # in build 4; 5.x is libxml++-5.0, which cyclus does not probe for
    - libxmlpp-devel 4.*
    # libxml++-4.0 is built on glibmm and cyclus links to libglibmm-2.68 directly
    # (Glib::ustring in relax_ng_validator.h); listed so its run_export applies
    # rather than relying on it arriving through libxmlpp-devel
    - glibmm-2.68
    - libxml2
    # headers and the libxml2.so dev symlink moved out of libxml2 in 2.14
    - libxml2-devel
    - liblapack
    - blis
    - hdf5
    - sqlite
    - glib
    - python
    # cyclus embeds the interpreter and links to libpython, which is a separate
    # package from Python 3.15 on (https://conda-forge.org/blog/2026/09/03/python-315/);
    # for older versions python already depends on the matching libpython
    - libpython
    - pandas
    - cython
    # build-time code generation runs under the host python; keeping jinja2 out
    # of build: avoids a second interpreter in BUILD_PREFIX that CMake finds first
    - jinja2
    # build backend of setup.py, used by the pip install below
    - setuptools
    # CMakeLists.txt installs the pure-python package with `python -m pip install
    # --no-deps --target=$SP_DIR .` at `make install` time (a failure there is
    # non-fatal); rattler-build's PIP_NO_BUILD_ISOLATION/PIP_NO_INDEX keep it offline
    - pip
  run:
    - coin-or-cbc
    - libboost-devel
    # the installed headers include libxml++ and glibmm headers
    - libxmlpp-devel 4.*
    - libxml2
    - liblapack
    - blis
    - hdf5
    - sqlite
    - glib
    - python
    - pandas
    - pprintpp
  run_exports:
    # downstream archetype libraries (e.g. cycamore) link to libcyclus
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("cyclus", upper_bound="x.x") }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      lib:
        - cyclus
      bin:
        - cyclus
        - cycpp.py
      files:
        - share/cyclus/cyclus_default_unit_test_driver.cc
        - share/cyclus/cyclus-flat.rng.in
        - share/cyclus/cyclus_nuc_data.h5
        - share/cyclus/cyclus.rng.in
        - share/cyclus/dbtypes.json

  - files:
      source:
        - tests
        - share/dbtypes.json
        - src/hdf5_back_gen.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - which
        - cxx-compiler
        - pytest
        - pytables
    script:
      - which cyclus

      - cyclus --version
      - cyclus --path
      - cyclus --include
      - cyclus --install-path
      - cyclus --cmake-module-path
      - cyclus --build-path
      - cyclus --rng-schema
      - cyclus --nuc-data

      - cyclus_unit_tests

      - cd tests
      - pytest -vv

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.rst
  summary: The agent-based fuel cycle simulator.
  homepage: https://fuelcycle.org/
  repository: http://github.com/cyclus/cyclus
  documentation: https://fuelcycle.org/
